items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I'd be another man here, Mr. Miller or something.

ctx.x: But never played a dance, people didn't? Never played a dance with them.

Oh yeah, the men would play dancing. They'd play a different office. I'd be another man here, Mr. Miller or something. They'd turn all that money in. Lewis walked out every dance he played in the book, every dance he played. We'd turn the money, we'd just show it. Yeah.
Well, after you got out of the WPA, did you play in the street any then? Oh yeah, I was playing.
